status.meaning: lifecycle state of the order (see the Ridgeline Orders & Delivery lifecycle)

order_number.meaning: order number shown in the order confirmation

merchandise_total.meaning: pre-tax merchandise total of the order

delivery_address.meaning: delivery address exactly as entered on the order; empty for pickup

delivery_window_start.meaning: start of the booked delivery window; empty when no window is booked

delivery_window_end.meaning: end of the booked delivery window; empty when no window is booked

haul_away_selected.meaning: whether haul-away of the old item was booked

ready_date.meaning: date the order became ready, shipped or loaded; empty until ready

pickup_deadline_date.meaning: last day a pickup order is held; empty for deliveries

fulfilled_at.meaning: moment of pickup or delivery; empty until fulfilled

fulfilled_date.meaning: date of pickup or delivery; empty until fulfilled

reschedule_count.meaning: number of customer reschedules of the delivery

cancelled_date.meaning: date the order was cancelled; empty unless cancelled

cancellation_reason.meaning: why the order was cancelled; not_cancelled otherwise

balance_due.meaning: amount currently owed; identically the sum of the order_balance deltas; negative means money is owed back

order_event_id.meaning: primary id of the order ledger or delivery line

order_id.meaning: order the line belongs to (foreign key -> orders)

customer_id.meaning: customer who placed the order (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type of the line, verbatim from the Ridgeline Orders & Delivery charter

order_number.meaning: order number exactly as on the order

amount.meaning: amount of the line, always positive; direction fixed by event_type; 0.00 on a delivery attempt line

fee_type.meaning: which charge a fee line bills; not_applicable otherwise

payment_method.meaning: tender of a payment; not_applicable otherwise

return_receipt_number.meaning: return receipt number printed at the return exactly as issued; empty otherwise

item_category.meaning: return policy category of returned items; not_applicable otherwise

return_reason.meaning: reason for a return; not_applicable otherwise

return_channel.meaning: how returned items came back; not_applicable otherwise

credit_type.meaning: which credit a credit line applies; not_applicable otherwise

order_request_id.meaning: request the line arises from (foreign key -> order_requests); empty otherwise

refund_method.meaning: tender a refund goes back to; not_applicable otherwise

original_event_id.meaning: payment line a refund refunds (foreign key -> order_events); empty otherwise

attempt_number.meaning: delivery attempt number on the order; 0 on other lines

attempt_outcome.meaning: outcome of a delivery attempt; not_applicable on other lines

arrived_at.meaning: moment the truck or driver arrived (delivery attempt lines only); empty otherwise

order_request_id.meaning: primary id of the order service request

customer_id.meaning: customer who made the request (foreign key -> customers)

order_id.meaning: order the request concerns (foreign key -> orders)

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

resolved_date.meaning: date the request was decided, completed or withdrawn; empty while submitted
